title: Refresh Delta
description: Records the differential between a prior artifact and its refreshed successor. Produced by cbm-refresh in modes structural and interpretive. Carries the trajectory of revision, not just the current state.

source_sha.description: The new HEAD SHA the refresh moved to.

refresh_mode.description: structural=Mode 3 (deterministic kernel re-run, downstream marked needs-review). interpretive=Mode 4 (Surface Mapper differential refresh, carrying forward prior interpretive claims where evidence unchanged).

source_sha.description: The source_sha the prior artifact was generated against.

summary.description: Prose summary of what changed between prior and successor: what kind of codebase change drove the refresh, how much carried forward, what's notably different.

carried_forward.description: Claims from the prior artifact that survived the refresh verbatim — citations resolve to unchanged bytes; register and status preserved.

successor_claim_id.description: If the successor uses a different id (e.g., re-numbering), record the mapping. Often same as claim_id.

updated.description: Claims whose evidence shifted but whose interpretive content survives the change. The producer re-examined and judged that the reading still holds; citations and evidence_kinds may differ in the successor.

what_changed.description: What in the evidence shifted, and why the claim still holds. References specific citations or files.

retracted.description: Claims that did not survive the refresh. Evidence no longer supports them; interpretive content no longer defensible at HEAD.

rationale.description: Why the claim was retracted: what changed in the codebase that broke it.

superseded_by.description: Optional: id of the successor claim that replaces this one (use when a claim is superseded rather than simply removed).

newly_added.description: Claims in the successor that did not exist in the prior. New surfaces, new edges, new authorities surfaced by the refresh.

rationale.description: What in the codebase change introduced this new claim.

newly_contested.description: Claims that survived the refresh but where the codebase change has surfaced an alternative reading not previously visible. Status moves from active to challenged.

challenges_carried_forward.description: Challenges from the prior artifact, classified by their status after refresh.

open_questions_reconciled.description: Open questions from the prior, classified by what the refresh did to them.

downstream_invalidation.description: Artifacts downstream of the refreshed one that are now stale and need review (intervention cards built on prior surface map, etc.).
